wiki.title: Doyle Heffley
wiki.extract: Doyle M. Heffley (born February 24, 1970) is an American politician, consultant, and member of the Republican Party. In 2010, he was elected to represent the 122nd District in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives. He ran for the position in 2008 against incumbent Keith McCall and lost. Heffley won the spot in 2010 Election after McCall retired and did not run for reelection.
